chunks: Sahl ibn al-Yasaʿ asked Abū al-Ḥasan al-Awwal عليه السلام:
about a man who performs the nāfilah prayer sitting while he has no illness, whether in travel or residence. He said: “There is no harm in that.”

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no harm in it; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to pray voluntary prayers sitting without an excuse?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning voluntary prayer. It states that performing the nāfilah prayer while seated is permissible even for one who has no illness, whether traveling or residing at home.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1047 - Sahl ibn al-Yas'a asked Abu Al-Hasan al-Awwal (as)

about a man who prays a voluntary prayer sitting while he does not have any illness, whether in travel or while at home.
Imam (as) said: "There is no harm in that”.
